summary: ZTO Express filed a Form 6-K announcing that its wholly-owned subsidiary has agreed to acquire the remaining 36.20% stake (567.5M shares) in TuXi Tech for an aggregate consideration of approximately RMB1,305.3 million (~$180M). The purchase price per share is approximately RMB2.30. After completion, TuXi Tech will become a wholly-owned subsidiary of ZTO. The sellers include connected persons of the company, making this a connected transaction under Hong Kong Listing Rules. The transaction qualifies for reporting and announcement requirements but is exempt from independent shareholder approval. Completion is subject to conditions in the respective share purchase agreements. The deal is a clean-up acquisition; watch for regulatory and closing conditions.
